level_1_scope_classifier.purpose: Binary scope guard to determine whether a query falls within industrial manufacturing and welding operations before invoking ML pipelines or LLM backends.

rule_precedence.name: keyword_matching
rule_precedence.mechanism: Iterates through frozenset `MANUFACTURING_KEYWORDS` (>200 curated terms). Multi-word phrases are checked as substrings; single-word terms are checked with regex word boundaries `\b<kw>\b` after lowercasing.

rule_precedence.name: regex_pattern_matching
rule_precedence.mechanism: Iterates through list `_PATTERNS` (9 precompiled regexes matching machine IDs, station patterns, line patterns, sensor/alarm occurrences, and thickness mentions).

rule_precedence.name: fallback_rejection
rule_precedence.mechanism: If neither keywords nor regex patterns match, returns out_of_scope.
rule_precedence.result: in_scope=False, matched_term='', reason='No manufacturing-related terms detected'

confidence_behavior.1.0: Assigned when a direct keyword or multi-word phrase matches from MANUFACTURING_KEYWORDS, or on out-of-scope fallback.
confidence_behavior.0.8: Assigned when a regex structural pattern matches (_PATTERNS) without an explicit vocabulary keyword.

level_1_scope_classifier.exception_handling: Pipelines wrap calls and raise `OutOfScopeError(question, result)` when `not result.in_scope`, returning a standardized rejection explanation.

level_2_routing_classifier.purpose: Deterministic rule-based router that assigns an in-scope question to the appropriate specialized pipeline.

rule_precedence.rule_logic: Matches non-welding manufacturing vocabulary in `_OTHER_MANUFACTURING_TERMS` (machining, CNC, milling, lathe, injection molding, casting, forging, sheet metal, stamping, additive/3D printing, heat treatment, GD&T, Six Sigma, Lean, 5S, OEE, takt time, BOM).
Requires both a recognized workpiece material (steel, stainless, aluminum) and plate thickness (`\d+\s*mm`).
Matches specific station or line references (`\b(?:station|line|machine)[_\s]?\d\b|\b[sm][123]\b`).

rule_precedence.condition: Default fallback for remaining in-scope questions
rule_precedence.rule_logic: Captures general welding knowledge, defect causes, troubleshooting, shielding gas selection, productivity, and Isaac Sim / robotics integration.

unified_intent_taxonomy.out_of_scope: Unsupported query rejected by classify_intent guard (chitchat, sports, trivia, cooking, etc.).
unified_intent_taxonomy.anomaly: Specific machine/station operational event, telemetry, or fault diagnosis query.
unified_intent_taxonomy.param: Welding parameter optimization query containing material and thickness specifications.
unified_intent_taxonomy.knowledge: General welding engineering advice (defects, troubleshooting, process comparisons, economics, robotics).
unified_intent_taxonomy.general: Non-welding manufacturing processes (CNC, molding, casting, stamping, additive, lean/OEE).
